paragraphs: LiveWire Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its consolidated subsidiaries are referred to in this Form 10-K as "we," "our," "us," the "Company," or "LiveWire." LiveWire is an industry-leading all-electric motorcycle brand with a focus on pioneering the growing two-wheel electric motorcycle space.

LiveWire was a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of AEA-Bridges Impact Corp ("ABIC"), which was originally incorporated as a Cayman Islands exempted company on July 29, 2020, as a special purpose acquisition company ("SPAC") with the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. In connection with the transactions (the "Business Combination") pursuant to the business combination agreement, dated as of December 12, 2021 (the "Business Combination Agreement"), by and among ABIC, LiveWire EV Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (now known as "LiveWire Group, Inc."), LW EV Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Merger Sub"), Harley-Davidson, Inc. ("H-D"), and LiveWire EV, LLC ("Legacy LiveWire"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of H-D, we entered into a number of agreements with H-D, including the Separation Agreement, dated as of September 26, 2022, by and between H-D and Legacy LiveWire and consummated the separation of the Legacy LiveWire business and other transaction contemplated by the Separation Agreement (the "Separation").

The Company assessed that it has two reportable segments based upon how management reviews the operations of the business: Electric Motorcycles ("Electric Motorcycles") and STACYC ("STACYC"). The Company's reportable segments are strategic business units that offer different products and services and are managed separately based on the fundamental differences in their operations. The Electric Motorcycles segment primarily focuses on the designing and selling of electric motorcycles and also sells electric motorcycle parts, accessories, and apparel. Electric motorcycles are sold at wholesale to a network of independent dealers and retailers, at retail through a Company-owned dealership, and through online sales. The STACYC segment primarily focuses on the designing and selling of electric balance bikes for kids, adult pedal assist electric bikes that were introduced in March 2025, and related parts and accessories. The STACYC segment products are sold at wholesale to independent dealers and independent distributors, as well as direct to consumers online.

LiveWire's vision is to lead the next generation of products that combine the experience of electric powertrains with the soulful connection that comes from riding. The underpinning strategy is to accelerate the electric vehicle transformation of the industry while building a leadership position in the market. Directing the shift to electric vehicles is a mission-driven leadership team with the competitive advantages of strategic partnerships with H-D and the KYMCO Group (Kwang Yang Motor Co., Ltd., KYMCO Capital Fund I Co., Ltd., SunBright Investment Co., Ltd., CycleLoop Co., Ltd. and Kwang Yang Holdings Limited (collectively, the "KYMCO Group")) and having a pipeline of future products for both Electric Motorcycles and STACYC youth segments. From advanced electric motorcycles to youth-focused balance bikes, the Electric Motorcycles and STACYC segments together represent a vision for the future – one that blends performance, accessibility, and global reach. We believe these portfolios signal the next step in shaping the next generation of twist & go riders and electric powersports enthusiasts worldwide.

Lead in Electric and the Transformation of Motorcycling - The electric vehicle market will include both established manufacturers and new entrants. To establish market share and scale our business, LiveWire plans to continue building global distribution capabilities and make investments in research and development for the commercialization of future generations of LiveWire electric motorcycles, related technologies and other products.

Capture Global Share of the Electric Motorcycle Market - LiveWire strategically selects our retail partners based upon their commitment to electric, location and capabilities to support the electric vehicle capture. Our 2026 priority markets include the United States, Canada and leading countries in Europe such as Germany, France, Switzerland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Poland, Portugal, Finland, Belgium and Luxembourg.

Lead in Brand Desirability - LiveWire's ambition is to create the most desirable electric motorcycle brand in the world. As a brand, LiveWire leverages Soulful by Design as its consumer-facing position. This differentiates LiveWire from others in the category, showcasing a rider's connection to the world through the LiveWire riding experience. LiveWire's go-to-market model allows for a consumer-defined journey across digital and physical platforms for an omni-channel experience.

Share the Love of Riding - STACYC's mission has been to Share the Love of Riding, designing and selling electric stability bikes for kids, enabling the development of their skillset and powering their journey to independence on two wheels while preparing them to become the next generation of riders. STACYC's current portfolio includes four sizes of product for kids ages 3 to 12, and an adult pedal-assist electric bike. The Company's priority markets continue to be North America, with expansion in Europe and Australia, selling through powersports dealers, in addition to digital channels, while leveraging licensing deals with traditional powersport Original Equipment Manufacturers ("OEM") to increase reach and scale.

LiveWire benefits from two important strategic partners: H-D and KYMCO Group. These partners have been selected based on their track record in their respective segments, the strength of their global capabilities, and the complementary fit with the LiveWire business. These partnerships give LiveWire a unique ability to deliver high-quality products to the global market in a capital-efficient approach.

H-D is one of the most recognized motorcycle brands in the world, with capabilities to design, develop, manufacture, market and distribute vehicles to major markets around the globe. Beyond the various service agreements tied to the Separation, LiveWire intends to leverage H-D's capabilities in two key areas: technical and other services and contract manufacturing.

The KYMCO Group sells a globally recognized brand of scooters, motorcycles and side-by-side ATVs. The KYMCO Group goes to market with a sales footprint covering over 100 countries, including a growing subset of electric vehicle-specific distribution points. In addition to core sales activities of the KYMCO Group brand, it is a trusted design and manufacturing partner to other premium two-wheel original equipment manufacturers.

LiveWire will draw on H-D's and the KYMCO Group's best-in-class operations, benefiting from knowledge, scale and infrastructure across material sourcing, electric vehicle building and global distribution.

In connection with the Business Combination, we entered into a number of agreements with H-D to govern the Separation and provide a framework for the relationship between the parties going forward pursuant to which we and/or H-D have continuing obligations to each other. All transactions with H-D subsequent to the Business Combination are considered related party transactions. Agreements that the Company entered into in connection with the Separation include:

On September 26, 2022, we entered into a master services agreement with H-D pursuant to which H-D provided us with certain services that we did not yet have the capability to perform for ourselves, including services related to testing and development, product regulatory support, color materials, finishes, paint and graphics, technical publication, application support and maintenance, service desk support, warehousing support, safety investigation, and marketing vehicle and fleet center, as we may request from time to time. On December 23, 2024, we entered into a new Master Services Agreement (the "Master Services Agreement") with H-D. The Master Services Agreement became effective on January 1, 2025, and terminated the master services agreement, dated September 26, 2022, between LiveWire and H-D. Pursuant to the Master Services Agreement, H-D will continue to provide LiveWire with certain services that LiveWire determined would be better outsourced at this time, including services that support testing and development, product regulatory support, color materials, finishes, paint and graphics, technical publication, application support and maintenance, service desk support, warehousing support, and other corporate support services. The new Master Services Agreement incorporates a subset of support services previously provided under the now expired Transition Services Agreement including services where LiveWire utilizes H-D's subject matter experts for targeted guidance or allow LiveWire to leverage H-D's systems or equipment for cost savings purposes. The Master Services Agreement contemplates that each of the services shall be provided to LiveWire as detailed under the terms of the Master Services Agreement and the exhibit thereto or as set forth in a separate, mutually agreed upon letter agreement. The Master Services Agreement also provides that any service or project not contemplated by the Master Services Agreement will be set forth in a separate, mutually agreed upon side letter or letter agreement, and any fee for such service or project will be separate than the fee provided for in the Master Services Agreement. The Master Services Agreement has an initial term of seven years and will be renewable upon mutual agreement. The Master Services Agreement or any related letter agreement for additional services may be terminated by either party upon the other party's material, uncured breach. H-D may also terminate the agreement upon LiveWire's change of control or, at the end of a calendar year upon 180 days written notice, in the event that LiveWire failed to engage H-D to manufacture at least forty percent of LiveWire's production during that calendar year. The charges for the services will be a flat monthly fee representing cost plus a markup. A joint steering committee composed of senior executives and/or designees of each party will meet annually to formulate a forecast and plan for LiveWire's anticipated service needs, as well as adjust the monthly fee as appropriate, and will oversee the progress of the services and address any disputes.

paragraphs: LiveWire Group, Inc. is subject to risks and uncertainties, including those discussed below. Discussions of our business and operations included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K should be read together with the risk factors set forth below. Some of these risks and uncertainties, including those described below, may cause our business, financial condition and results of operations to vary, and they may materially or adversely affect our financial performance. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Other risks and uncertainties, which are not currently known to us or which we currently believe are immaterial, may also materially or adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. References to "electric vehicles" throughout this Risk Factors section refer to electric motorcycles, electric balance bikes, and electric bikes.

Our business is subject to a number of risks and uncertainties, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, strategies or prospects. An investment in LiveWire involves risks, including those discussed below. These risk factors should be considered carefully before deciding whether to invest in the Company.

•We are an early-stage company with a history of losses and expect to incur significant expenses and continuing losses for several years. We have yet to achieve positive operating cash flow and, given our projected funding needs, our ability to generate positive cash flow is uncertain.
•Our research and development efforts may not yield the expected results, or results on expected timelines or at expected costs.
•Increases in costs, disruption of supply, or shortage of materials and components necessary for our electric vehicles, could materially and negatively affect our business.
•Our limited operating history makes evaluating our business and future prospects difficult.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis is intended to help the reader understand LiveWire, our financial condition and results of operations, and our present business environment. The following discussion and analysis should be read together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Form 10-K. The following discussion may contain forward-looking statements. Actual results could differ materially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to these differences include those factors discussed below and elsewhere in this Form 10-K, particularly in "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Risk Factors" discussions.

LiveWire is an industry-leading all-electric vehicle brand with a mission to pioneer the rapidly growing two-wheel electric motorcycle space. The Company operates in two segments: Electric Motorcycles and STACYC.

The Electric Motorcycles segment sells electric motorcycles, related parts and accessories and apparel in the United States and certain international markets, while the STACYC segment sells electric balance bikes, electric bikes, related parts and accessories and apparel in the United States and certain international markets. The STACYC segment launched an adult pedal assist electric bike in the United States in March 2025.

Electric motorcycles are sold at wholesale to a network of Independent Retail Partners, at retail through a Company-owned dealership and through online sales. Prior to November 5, 2024, the Company's products were sold at retail through select international partners primarily in Europe. Electric balance bikes and electric bikes are sold at wholesale to independent dealers and independent distributors, as well as direct to customers online. As discussed below, on September 26, 2022 as part of the
Business Combination, the Company, which included LiveWire branded electric motorcycles and STACYC, became a separate, publicly traded company.

During the third quarter of 2025, the Company initiated the "Twist & Go Promotion" offering temporary pricing incentives on its S2 electric motorcycles from August 28, 2025 to October 31, 2025, which resulted in increased sales volumes in the third quarter of 2025. In late October 2025, the promotion was extended by the Company through December 15, 2025.

LiveWire's net loss for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $75,114 thousand compared to $93,925 thousand for the year ended December 31, 2024. LiveWire's net losses reflect the early-stage nature of LiveWire's business including investments in product development as LiveWire continues to focus on technological innovation that it expects will support future products and growth.

The Electric Motorcycles segment operating loss for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $73,831 thousand, compared to an operating loss of $105,500 thousand for the year ended December 31, 2024. Refer to the Electric Motorcycles segment analysis below for further discussion.

The STACYC segment operating loss for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $1,653 thousand, as compared to operating loss of $4,856 thousand for the year ended December 31, 2024. Refer to the STACYC segment analysis below for further discussion.

In response to the market challenges facing the electric vehicle segment and the overall boarder powersports industry, the Company is continuing to focus on strategic expansion of its product offerings, including the planned production in the spring of 2026 of two new 125 cc-equivalent mini-motos, the S4 HonchoTM products, which are designed to expand access and affordability for riders globally. As the Company evaluates its long-term strategy and product offerings, it will continue to focus on cost savings to reduce cash usage while focusing on developing and producing profitable products to align with evolving customer preferences and broader electric vehicle adoption trends that will allow the Company to continue to reduce operating losses and fund its operations through profitability.

On August 22, 2025, LiveWire entered into an At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Mizuho Securities USA LLC, as agent (the "Agent"), under which LiveWire may offer and sell, from time to time at its sole discretion, an aggregate gross sale price of up to $50.0 million of shares of its common stock through the Agent (the "ATM Program"), pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (Registration No. 333-289699), which was declared effective by the SEC on August 21, 2025. LiveWire filed a prospectus supplement with the SEC on August 22, 2025 in connection with the ATM Program.

On December 12, 2021, H-D entered into the Business Combination Agreement with ABIC, to effect the separation of its electric vehicle business. On September 16, 2022, the Business Combination was approved in an ABIC shareholder vote, and it closed on September 26, 2022.

The Business Combination was accounted for as a reverse recapitalization. Under this method of accounting, ABIC was treated as the "acquired" company for financial reporting purposes. Accordingly, the Business Combination was treated as the equivalent of LiveWire issuing stock for the net assets of ABIC, accompanied by a recapitalization. The net assets of ABIC were stated at historical cost, with no goodwill or other intangible assets recorded resulting from the Business Combination. Operations prior to the Business Combination are those of Legacy LiveWire.

Upon closing of the Business Combination and PIPE Investments, the most significant change in the Company's future reported financial position and results was an increase in cash due to net proceeds received of approximately $293.7 million, including a $100.0 million investment from the Legacy LiveWire Equityholder and a $100.0 million investment from certain members of the KYMCO Group, through a PIPE. Additionally, the increase in cash reflects the amount of cash released from ABIC's trust account of $13.6 million (net of the SPAC share redemption amount) and the $100.0 million equity backstop (the "H-D Backstop Amount") provided by H-D in exchange for 10,000,000 shares of Common Stock for a purchase price of $10.00 per share pursuant to the terms of the Business Combination Agreement.

paragraphs: LiveWire Group, Inc., 一間 Delaware 公司，及其合併子公司，在本 Form 10-K 中被稱為 "we," "our," "us," 本公司，或 "LiveWire." LiveWire 是一間在電動二輪機車領域具有領導地位的品牌，專注於開拓成長中的電動二輪機車市場。

LiveWire 是 AEA-Bridges Impact Corp ("ABIC") 的直接、完全擁有子公司，ABIC 原為一間於 2020 年 7 月 29 日在開曼羣島註冊的豁免公司，作為一間特殊目的收購公司 ("SPAC")，其目的為進行與一間或多間企業或實體的合併、股權交換、資產收購、股權購買、重組或類似商業結合。根據業務結合協議 ("Business Combination Agreement")，於 2021 年 12 月 12 日簽訂，由 ABIC、LiveWire EV Holdings, Inc.（一間 Delaware 公司，現稱為 "LiveWire Group, Inc."）、LW EV Merger Sub, Inc.（一間 Delaware 公司，"Merger Sub"）、Harley-Davidson, Inc.（"H-D"）及 LiveWire EV, LLC（"Legacy LiveWire"）簽訂，我們與 H-D 籤訂了數項協議，包括於 2022 年 9 月 26 日簽訂的分離協議，並完成了 Legacy LiveWire 事業及其他根據分離協議預期進行的交易（"Separation"）。

本公司評估後認為，根據管理層如何審視業務運作，本公司有兩個應報告分部：電動機車（"Electric Motorcycles"）及 STACYC（"STACYC"）。本公司應報告分部為戰略性業務單位，提供不同產品與服務，並根據其運作的基本差異而分別管理。電動機車分部主要專注於電動機車的設計與銷售，同時也銷售電動機車零組件、配件與服飾。電動機車主要以整批方式銷售給獨立經銷商與零售商，透過本公司自有經銷店零售，以及透過線上銷售。STACYC 分部主要專注於設計與銷售電動平衡腳踏車給兒童、於 2025 年 3 月推出的成人輔助電動腳踏車，以及相關零組件與配件。STACYC 分部產品以整批方式銷售給獨立經銷商與獨立經銷商，以及直接透過線上銷售給消費者。

LiveWire 的願景是領導下一代產品，結合電動動力系統的體驗與騎乘時的靈魂連結。其核心策略是加速產業的電動車轉型，同時建立市場領導地位。推動電動車轉型是由使命驅動的領導團隊，擁有與 H-D 及 KYMCO 羣組（Kwang Yang Motor Co., Ltd., KYMCO Capital Fund I Co., Ltd., SunBright Investment Co., Ltd., CycleLoop Co., Ltd. 及 Kwang Yang Holdings Limited， collectively，"KYMCO 羣組"）的戰略合作夥伴關係，並擁有電動機車與 STACYC 青少年分部的未來產品管道。從先進的電動機車到專注於兒童的平衡腳踏車，電動機車與 STACYC 分部共同代表了一種未來的願景——融合性能、可近性與全球影響力。我們相信這些產品線標誌著塑造下一代電動機車騎士與電動運動愛好者的下一步。
領導電動與摩托車產業轉型 - 電動車市場將包括既有製造商與新進企業。為建立市佔率與擴大業務規模，LiveWire 計畫持續建設全球分銷能力，並投資於研究與開發，以實現未來世代 LiveWire 電動機車、相關技術及其他產品的商業化。
掌握全球電動機車市場份額 - LiveWire 戰略性地選擇零售夥伴，基於其對電動的承諾、地理位置及支持電動車市場的能力建設。我們 2026 年的重點市場包括美國、加拿大及歐洲的主要國家，如德國、法國、瑞士、荷蘭、英國、西班牙、義大利、波蘭、葡萄牙、芬蘭、比利時及盧森堡。
領導品牌吸引力 - LiveWire 的願景是創造世界上最受歡迎的電動機車品牌。作為一個品牌，LiveWire 透過 Soulful by Design 作為面對消費者的定位。這使其與同類品牌有所區別，展現騎士透過 LiveWire 騎行體驗與世界的連結。LiveWire 的上市模式允許消費者在數位與實體平台間自訂旅程，提供全通路體驗。

分享騎乘的喜悅 - STACYC 的使命是分享騎乘的喜悅，設計與銷售電動穩定腳踏車給兒童，幫助他們發展技能，並透過兩輪車的旅程培養他們成為下一代騎士的基礎。STACYC 目前的產品組合包括為 3 至 12 歲兒童設計的四種尺寸產品，以及一款成人輔助電動腳踏車。本公司持續將重點市場放在北美，並擴展至歐洲與澳洲，透過電動運動經銷商銷售，同時透過數位通路，並利用與傳統電動運動原廠製造商（"OEM"）的授權合作，以增加影響力與規模。
LiveWire 從兩位重要的戰略夥伴獲益：H-D 與 KYMCO Group。這些夥伴是根據其在各自領域的歷史表現、全球能力的強度，以及與 LiveWire 事業的補充契合度而選定的。這些合作關係使 LiveWire 具備獨特的能力，以資本效率的方式向全球市場提供高品質的產品。
H-D 是全球最受認可的機車品牌之一，具備設計、開發、製造、行銷及向全球主要市場分銷車輛的能力。除了與分離有關的各種服務協議外，LiveWire 預計將利用 H-D 在兩個關鍵領域的能力：技術及其他服務，以及合同製造。
KYMCO Group 售賣一個全球知名的機車、機踏車及側邊四輪 ATV 品牌。KYMCO Group 透過涵蓋超過 100 個國家的銷售據點進入市場，包括一個正在成長的電動車專用分銷點子集。除了 KYMCO Group 品牌的核心銷售活動外，它也是其他高階兩輪原廠設備製造商的可信設計與製造夥伴。
LiveWire 將利用 H-D 與 KYMCO Group 的最佳運作，從材料採購、電動車製造與全球分銷的知識、規模與基礎設施中獲益。
在與企業合併的關係中，我們與 H-D 籤訂了若干協議，以規範分離事宜並為雙方未來的關係提供框架，根據此框架，我們與/或 H-D 之間仍有持續的義務。所有與 H-D 之後的交易均被視為關聯交易。與分離相關的協議包括：

於 2022 年 9 月 26 日，我們與 H-D 籤訂了一項主服務協議，根據此協議，H-D 向我們提供我們尚未具備自行執行能力的某些服務，包括與測試與開發、產品法規支援、色彩材料、外觀、塗裝與圖案、技術出版物、應用支援與維護、服務臺支援、倉儲支援、安全調查以及車輛與車隊中心的行銷相關服務，如我們不時要求。於 2024 年 12 月 23 日，我們與 H-D 籤訂了一項新的主服務協議（"主服務協議"）。主服務協議於 2025 年 1 月 1 日生效，並終止了於 2022 年 9 月 26 日之間 LiveWire 與 H-D 簽訂的主服務協議。根據主服務協議，H-D 將繼續為 LiveWire 提供 LiveWire 認為目前較適合委外的某些服務，包括支援測試與開發、產品法規支援、色彩材料、外觀、塗裝與圖案、技術出版物、應用支援與維護、服務臺支援、倉儲支援及其他企業支援服務。新的主服務協議 incorporates 一項先前於現已過期的過渡服務協議中提供的支援服務子集，包括 LiveWire 利用 H-D 的專門領域專家進行針對性指導，或讓 LiveWire 借鑑 H-D 的系統或設備以達到節省成本的目的。主服務協議預期所有服務將根據主服務協議及其附屬文件的條款或雙方另行同意的書面協議中詳細說明。主服務協議也規定，任何未包含於主服務協議中的服務或專案將於雙方另行同意的書面協議中說明，且該服務或專案的費用將與主服務協議中規定的費用分開計算。主服務協議的初始期限為七年，雙方同意可續約。主服務協議或任何與額外服務相關的書面協議，如任一方因另一方的重大違約且未補救而可終止。H-D 也可因 LiveWire 的控制權變更而終止協議，或在財年結束時，若 LiveWire 未委託 H-D 至少製造 LiveWire 生產量的百分之四十，H-D 也可在給予 180 天書面通知後終止協議。服務費用將為每月固定費用，代表成本加上 markup。由雙方高階主管及/或指定代表組成的聯合指導委員會將每年會面，以制定 LiveWire 預期服務需求的預測與計畫，並適時調整每月費用，同時監督服務進度並處理任何爭議。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析旨在協助讀者瞭解 LiveWire、我們的財務狀況與營運成果，以及我們目前的商業環境。以下討論與分析應與本 Form 10-K 其他部分所載之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。以下討論可能包含前瞻性陳述。實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述中所討論者有重大差異。導致或促成這些差異的因素包括下列及本 Form 10-K 其他部分所討論的因素，特別是在『前瞻性陳述之謹慎說明』及『風險因素』討論中。
LiveWire 是一家領導業界的所有電動車品牌，其使命是開拓快速成長的兩輪電動機車市場。本公司經營兩個應報告分部：電動機車與 STACYC。
電動機車分部銷售電動機車、相關零組件與配件及服飾，銷售範圍包括美國及部分國際市場，而 STACYC 分部銷售電動平衡腳踏車、電動腳踏車、相關零組件與配件及服飾，銷售範圍包括美國及部分國際市場。STACYC 分部於 2025 年 3 月在美國推出成人輔助腳踏電動腳踏車。
電動機車以整批方式銷售給一連串獨立零售夥伴，並透過本公司自有經銷商及線上銷售方式零售。在 2024 年 11 月 5 日之前，本公司產品主要透過選擇性的國際夥伴在歐洲等地零售銷售。電動平衡腳踏車及電動腳踏車以整批方式銷售給獨立經銷商與獨立經銷商，並直接透過線上銷售方式對客戶銷售。如下列所討論，本公司於 2022 年 9 月 26 日作為
企業併購，本公司包含LiveWire品牌電動機車與STACYC，成為一家獨立、公開上市的公司。
在2025年第三季，本公司啟動了「Twist & Go促銷活動」，於2025年8月28日至2025年10月31日期間，對其S2電動機車提供臨時價格優惠，導致2025年第三季銷售量增加。在2025年10月下旬，本公司將促銷活動延長至2025年12月15日。
LiveWire 的淨虧損於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年為 75,114 千美元，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日財年為 93,925 千美元相比。LiveWire 的淨虧損反映其業務仍處於早期階段，包括對產品開發的投資，因 LiveWire 繼續專注於科技創新，其預期將支持未來產品與成長。
電動機車分部在2025年12月31日財年營運虧損為73,831 千美元，較2024年12月31日財年營運虧損105,500 千美元為少。有關電動機車分部的進一步討論，請參閱下方電動機車分部分析。
STACYC 業務分部於 2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之營運虧損為 1,653 千美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之營運虧損 4,856 千美元為少。有關 STACYC 業務分部之進一步討論，請參閱下列 STACYC 業務分部分析。

為應對電動車業務分部及總體電動機車產業所面臨之市場挑戰，本公司持續著重於產品線之戰略擴張，包括預計於 2026 年春季生產兩款新 125 cc 等效迷你機車，即 S4 HonchoTM 產品，此產品設計用以 globally 增進騎士之可近性與負擔能力。在本公司評估其長期策略與產品線時，將持續著重於成本節省以減少現金使用，同時專注於開發與生產獲利產品，以符合演進中之客戶偏好與廣泛電動車採用趨勢，使本公司得以持續減少營運虧損並透過獲利支應其營運。

2025 年 8 月 22 日，LiveWire 與 Mizuho Securities USA LLC 簽訂 At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement，由 Mizuho Securities USA LLC 作為經紀人（"經紀人"），LiveWire 可依其單方判斷，不時以總銷售價格最高達 50.0 百萬美元之方式，透過經紀人出售其普通股股份（"ATM 程式"），依據有效之 Form S-3 登記聲明書（註冊號碼 333-289699），該聲明書於 2025 年 8 月 21 日經 SEC 聲明生效。LiveWire 於 2025 年 8 月 22 日向 SEC 提交與 ATM 程式相關之發行說明書補充文件。
2021 年 12 月 12 日，H-D 與 ABIC 簽訂商業組合協議，以實現其電動車業務之分離。2022 年 9 月 16 日，商業組合經 ABIC 股東投票批准，並於 2022 年 9 月 26 日完成。
此商業組合被視為反向重組。根據此會計方法，ABIC 被視為 "被收購" 之公司，於財務報導目的。因此，此商業組合被視為 LiveWire 發行股票換取 ABIC 之淨資產，並伴隨重組。ABIC 之淨資產以歷史成本計價，商業組合未產生任何商譽或其他無形資產。商業組合前之營運為 Legacy LiveWire 之營運。

商業組合完成及 PIPE 投資後，本公司未來報導財務狀況與結果之最重大變動為現金增加，因收到淨資金約 293.7 百萬美元，包括來自 Legacy LiveWire 股東之 100.0 百萬美元投資，以及來自 KYMCO 羣體部分成員之 100.0 百萬美元投資，透過 PIPE。此外，現金增加反映來自 ABIC 信託帳戶之現金釋放 13.6 百萬美元（扣除 SPAC 股票贖回金額），以及 H-D 提供之 100.0 百萬美元權益保證（"H-D 保證金額"），以換取 10,000,000 股普通股，每股價格為 10.00 美元，依商業組合協議之條款。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
本公司研究與開發工作可能無法達成預期結果，或在預期時間內或預期成本下達成結果。
成本增加、供應中斷或電動車所需材料及零組件短缺，可能對本公司業務造成重大且負面影響。
本公司有限的營運歷史使評估本公司業務及未來前景變得困難。
本公司可能無法開發並大量生產具足夠品質、符合時程且能吸引廣大客戶羣的電動車。
電動車產業正在成長，本公司產品及服務將面臨來自競爭對手的競爭。
H-D 可能為其整體業務利益做出決策，此等決策可能對本公司整體業務造成負面影響。
本公司與 H-D 之間的關係可能影響我們其他商業關係或潛在商業關係。
利用合同製造商，包括 H-D、KYMCO Group 以及其他潛在夥伴，進行電動車合同製造，會面臨風險。
本公司業務的成功取決於電動車充電設施的可得性。該設施的限制可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
我們在國際市場擴展業務和運營可能面臨挑戰，且本公司在國際市場進行業務的能力可能因法律、法規、政治和經濟風險而受到不利影響。
電池的續航里程和使用壽命會隨著使用和時間而下降，若此情況重大，可能對潛在客戶購買我們電動車的決定產生負面影響。
現有營業場地租約意外終止，或未能續約，或未能以可接受的條款續約，可能對本公司業務產生重大且不利的影響。
本公司會受到與環境、社會及治理（"ESG"）事項相關的監督。
paragraphs: LiveWire Group, Inc. 面臨風險與不確定性，包括以下所討論的風險。本年報 10-K 所包含的業務與運營討論應與以下所列的風險因素一同閱讀。部分這些風險與不確定性，包括以下所描述的，可能導致本公司業務、財務狀況與運營結果產生變動，並可能對財務表現造成重大或不利影響。以下所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。其他風險與不確定性，包括目前尚未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要的風險，也可能對本公司業務、財務狀況與運營結果造成重大或不利影響。本風險因素部分中提及的 "電動車" 係指電動機車、電動平衡單車與電動腳踏車。
本公司業務面臨多種風險與不確定性，包括可能導致本公司無法達成業務目標或對業務、財務狀況、運營結果、現金流、策略或前景造成不利影響的風險。投資 LiveWire 涉及風險，包括以下所討論的風險。在決定是否投資本公司前，應謹慎考慮這些風險因素。
•本公司為早期階段公司，具有虧損的歷史，並預期在數年內持續產生重大支出與虧損。本公司尚未實現正向營運現金流，且根據預期資金需求，本公司產生正向現金流的能力存在不確定性。
•本公司研究與開發努力可能無法產生預期結果，或在預期時間內或預期成本下產生結果。
•成本增加、供應中斷或本公司電動車所需材料與零組件短缺，可能對本公司業務造成重大且負面影響。
•本公司有限的營運歷史使評估業務與未來前景變得困難。
